title: The Captain and the Mechanic
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: night, violent storm, slate-blue and grey palette, driving rain, lightning flashes.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking.
Camera: continuous medium tracking shot moving backward along the curved catwalk ahead of the pair; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Tomkin marches boldly along the storm-lashed catwalk, ladle raised like a rapier, cape snapping in the gale, butter tub tucked under one arm; Penny follows in the wind, one hand on the railing, rag fluttering, rain streaming off the iron.
Dialogue: Tomkin (pompous, theatrical, swashbuckling-captain male voice, a little squeaky, grandly overconfident, grand and defiant) says: "Forward! The sea shall know our courage!" Penny (calm, practical, quick-witted teenage girl's voice, dryly amused, shouted over the wind) says: "Watch your footing, Captain."
Sound: howling gale, driving rain on iron, metallic creaks, footsteps on wet grating, thunder.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
